project.title: NouGenStocks
project.description: A clean, fast market dashboard starter. The current UI uses clearly labeled sample data and is ready for a quote provider and backend integration.

sections.title: Data and security
sections.content: The starter does not present sample prices as live market data. Connect a server-side quote adapter before enabling live status. Keep provider credentials on the server; do not put secret keys in `VITE_*` variables.
